name: @error-tracker/react
description: React adapter for Error Tracker SDK.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:types
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.tsx --outdir dist --entry-naming '[dir]/index.js' --target browser --format esm --sourcemap --external react --external @error-tracker/sdk
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.tsx --outdir dist --entry-naming '[dir]/index.cjs' --target browser --format cjs --sourcemap --external react --external @error-tracker/sdk
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run build && npm pack --dry-run
